subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should persistent question summaries plus Control UI composer takeover be accepted as the supported cross-platform question interaction model after the channel wording and native proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing behavior change across Apple, Android, and web rather than a narrowly established bug fix; the protected maintainer signal requires an explicit owner decision on the intended permanent interaction model.

options.title: Sponsor the parity direction
options.body: Approve persistent summaries and composer takeover as the intended model after the docs scope is corrected and native runtime proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only the independently approved client behaviors and defer any unconfirmed cross-client interaction-policy changes to a smaller follow-up.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the parity direction
recommendation.body: Approve persistent summaries and composer takeover as the intended model after the docs scope is corrected and native runtime proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the only evidenced author of the integrated question-surface design and implementation.
